description: Land Acquisition - Yakalla, Ibbagamuwa D/S Division, Kurunegala District
categorisation: This gazette content is a land acquisition notice under the Land Acquisition Act, declaring that specific parcels of land are needed for a public purpose. It provides detailed descriptions of multiple land lots, including their extents, boundaries, and locations. The content deals exclusively with land matters (acquisition for public purpose), fitting the definition of Type 4 (Land Gazettes) for land and property-related administrative matters.
